mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuthRequired removes the boundary check; injecting an Operation that is unauthenticated yet Permitted forces a counterexample within the Alloy scope.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthBypass { some op: Operation | no op.authenticated and op.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_CareTeamGating lets a clinician obtain Permitted on records-lookup without an active care-team membership; the injection constructs exactly that situation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoCareTeam { some op: Operation | op.kind = PostRecordsLookup and op.outcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.member = op.caller and m.forPatient = op.resolvedPatient and some m.isActive) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the byte-equivalence fact and injecting a Denied operation whose response is not the canonical NotFoundShape exposes a leakage path.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakResponse { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Denied and op.response != NotFoundShape }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the always-on-audit constraint and injecting an authenticated records-lookup with no audit entry breaks SC-001/SC-002.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAudit { some op: Operation | op.kind = PostRecordsLookup and some op.authenticated and no op.auditEntry }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the attribution pin lets the recorded clinician drift away from the operation's caller — structurally indistinguishable from a post-hoc mutation of the audit row.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BadAttribution { some op: Operation | some op.auditEntry and op.auditEntry.recordedClinician != op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without F_IGOnlyAuditEndpoint, a clinical-role caller could obtain a Permitted on /audit/search, leaking the endpoint's existence to non-IG users.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonIGAuditAccess { some op: Operation | op.kind = PostAuditSearch and op.caller.role != AuditOfficer and op.outcome = Permitted }
